prompt_template: One photorealistic adult horse, full body with all four hooves and both ears in frame, standing in three-quarter profile facing left, pale Roman plaster and wooden stable background, grey stone floor, neutral daylight; no tack, rider, text, logo or watermark. 3:2 landscape.

white.promptVariant: a pure white coat with an ivory-white mane and tail, dark eyes and a pale grey muzzle

grey.promptVariant: a cool medium-grey coat with subtle dapples, a darker charcoal mane and tail, dark eyes

light_brown.promptVariant: a light warm chestnut-brown coat, rich chestnut mane and tail, dark eyes, NOT blond or beige

dark_brown.promptVariant: a dark chocolate bay-brown coat, black mane and tail, dark eyes

black.promptVariant: a deep natural jet-black coat with soft readable highlights, black mane and tail, dark eyes

pinto.promptVariant: a light chestnut-brown coat with large clearly visible irregular white patches on the body, a broad white blaze on the face and white socks, brown and ivory mane

caramel.promptVariant: a medium caramel-brown coat in between light chestnut and dark brown, warm golden-brown body with a dark brown mane and tail, dark eyes
